Card Q&A.a: No. If you didn't trash any digivolution cards with the [When Attacking] effect, you don't get to trigger  or gain 1 memory.
Card Q&A.q: When this Digimon attacked, my opponent didn't have any Digimon with digivolution cards, and I wasn't able to use the [When Attacking] effect to trash digivolution cards. Do I still get to trigger  and gain 1 memory?

Effect: [When Attacking] Trash the bottom digivolution card of 1 of your opponent's Digimon. When you do, trigger ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck) and gain 1 memory.
